tools.name: check_exact_domain
tools.description: Check whether an exact domain name is available to register. Use when the user asks if a specific domain is taken, free, or available.

tools.name: batch_check_domains
tools.description: Check availability for up to 20 exact domain names at once. Use when the user lists several domains to compare.

tools.name: find_available_domains
tools.description: Suggest available domain names for a business, brand or idea. Use when the user wants domain ideas rather than checking one exact name.
